battery.instructions: Do not dispose in regular waste. Take to specialized battery collection bins at retailers or recycling depots.

can.instructions: Empty contents, rinse lightly. Aluminum and steel cans are 100% infinitely recyclable.

cardboard.instructions: Flatten corrugated boxes to save space. Keep dry and free of greasy food stains.

drink carton.instructions: Tetra Pak & aseptic cartons have plastic/aluminum liners. Rinse, push straws inside, and recycle where carton facilities exist.

glass bottle.instructions: Empty and rinse. Keep caps on or separate metal lids. Do not break.

paper.instructions: Clean dry office paper, newspaper, and flyers. Wet or food-stained paper goes into compost or general waste.

plastic bag.instructions: DO NOT place in domestic curbside bins as bags tangle sorting machinery. Return clean bags to supermarket drop-off hubs.

plastic bottle.instructions: Empty liquid, rinse, squash bottle flat, and screw the cap back on.

plastic bottle cap.instructions: Small loose caps can fall through sorting sieves; screw tightly onto clean empty plastic bottles.

pop tab.instructions: Leave attached to the can or drop inside an empty aluminum can to avoid losing small parts.

organic.instructions: Food scraps, fruit peels, and garden waste. Decomposes naturally into compost.

glass.instructions: 100% recyclable bottles and jars. Empty and rinse.

metal.instructions: Aluminum and steel are infinitely recyclable.

plastic.instructions: Rigid plastics (types 1, 2, and 5) are widely recyclable.

textile.instructions: Donate usable clothes to charity. Worn-out textiles should go to textile banks.

ewaste.instructions: Electronics contain toxic substances and valuable metals. Never put in general waste.

bottle.instructions: Empty liquid, rinse, and place in plastics or glass recycling.

cup.instructions: Rinse clean. Take single-use coffee cups to specialized cup drop-offs.

phone.instructions: Contains lithium battery and circuit boards. Recycle at designated e-waste drop-offs.

book.instructions: Recycle with clean paper and cardboard.
